Watchouts and Buyer Questions

Handling Objections

  • Noise: verify floor, block, and management rules before the buyer commits.
  • Maintenance: review AGM minutes, service charge, and sinking fund details before presenting.
  • Access: check the security flow at viewing time and confirm the gated-entry experience.
  • Developer: anchor the conversation on completed projects and current management quality.
  • Pricing: present active asking prices as directional context, not a valuation.
  • Comparison: adjust for floor plan, facing, condition, and renovation quality.
  • Goal: help the buyer make a calm, informed decision about The Peak Condominium.
